recent: Chin Hin Group Berhad 与 PMCK Berhad 签署条款清单，拟在吉打州 Alor Setar 合资开发一家拥有 300 张床位的私立医院，项目价值约 RM376 million，并计划在马六甲开展另一项医疗保健项目。公司近期有多项董事及大股东持股变动的申报，包括执行主席 Datuk Wira Chiau Haw Choon 的间接持股减持。最新季度（2026年6月30日止）营收环比增长 12.9%，但净利环比下降 55.9%。
notable: 与 PMCK Berhad 签署条款清单，拟合资在吉打州开发拥有 300 张床位的私立医院，项目价值约 RM376 million。

recent_en: Chin Hin Group Berhad signed a term sheet with PMCK Berhad to jointly develop a 300-bed private hospital in Alor Setar, Kedah, valued at approximately RM376 million, with plans for another healthcare project in Melaka. The company recently had several filings on changes in directors' and substantial shareholders' interests, including a decrease in indirect holdings by Executive Chairman Datuk Wira Chiau Haw Choon. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue rose 12.9% QoQ but net profit fell 55.9% QoQ.
notable_en: Signed a term sheet with PMCK Berhad to jointly develop a 300-bed private hospital in Kedah valued at approximately RM376 million.
Plans another healthcare project in Melaka.
risks_en: Executive Chairman Datuk Wira Chiau Haw Choon disposed of 6,500,000 indirect shares at RM2.00 per share on 19 October 2026.
Executive Chairman Datuk Wira Chiau Haw Choon disposed of 5,650,000 indirect shares at RM2.08 per share on 28 August 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM1,052.62 million, up 12.9% QoQ and 10.3% YoY; net profit was RM9.03 million, down 55.9% QoQ and 59.7% YoY; net margin was 0.9%, lower than 2.2% in the previous quarter.
